confirmed_examples.source: It needs a coffin, not a knife.

identity: Body area sensor networks were developed as unobtrusive, chip-free personalized medical devices, typically in the form of thin adhesive pads.  Hub 01 has adapted this technology into cybernetic implants that allow a neurobionic interface to communicate with external devices.  These implants will allow your neurobionic interface to communicate with Hub 01 Lower Extremity Gaitframes.

identity: Draw on the dreams of a sleeping mortal, condensing them into dreamdross.  When so harnessed, the target requires a period of time after to recover before their dreams are once again suitable for harvesting.  A mortal whose dreams are harvested will also be depressed for a time afterwards.
